how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form; a sample copy is on https://srnmartscollegevalia.org.
Attach bio-data, recent passport size photograph and self-attested copies of UG/PG/Ph.D./Research certificates, API score and experience certificates.

If currently employed, send the application with a No Objection Certificate through the employer.
